safety_policy.excluded_content: Source-era claims about suicide, insanity, death, lifespan prediction, seduction/illegitimacy, and criminality are intentionally NOT encoded. Adjacent structural features are encoded with softened, wellbeing-safe interpretations and safety_class='sensitive'.
safety_policy.life_line_framing: Life line is ALWAYS framed as vitality/energy, never lifespan.
safety_policy.narrator_rule: Rules with safety_class='sensitive' must be softened or omitted by the narrator; never present as deterministic health/fate outcomes.

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki tarjani (Jupiter finger) asadharan roop se lambi hai — netritva, mahatvakanksha aur niyam banane ki natural shakti ka sanket. Aap logon ko organize karne aur aage se lead karne ke liye bane hain.

Anamika (Sun finger) tarjani se kaafi lambi hai aur Surya rekha bhi maujood hai — paison ke maamle mein risk lene ki prabal ichchha. Calculated risk aapko suit karta hai, lekin impulse decisions se bachna zaroori hai.

Kanishtika (little finger) lambi hai — vaani ki shakti aur shabdon ka jaadu aapka gift hai. Bolne, samjhane aur convince karne ke kaam (sales, teaching, public speaking, content) mein aap naturally chamakte hain.
Chhoti kanishtika ka matlab hai bolne se zyada likhne mein aapki taakat hai. Naye logon ke saamne sankoch swabhavik hai — lekin likhit shabd aapke vichaaron ko poori shakti se pahunchate hain.
Tarjani aur anamika bilkul barabar — santulit mastishk ka durlabh sanket. Ambition aur creativity aapke andar perfect balance mein hain; na zyada dikhawa, na kam aatmavishwas.
Angushtha ka nail-parv lamba aur pat­la hai — shaant, adrishya lekin atoot willpower. Aap bina shor machaye apni baat manwate hain aur gusse par poora niyantran rakhte hain.

sources.loc: Preface: Character Shown by the Thumb

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Angushtha hatheli se sata hua hai — savdhaan aur suraksha-pradhan swabhav. Paise ko sambhal kar rakhna aapki taakat hai, lekin kabhi-kabhi naye avsar par 'haan' kehna seekhna faydemand rahega.

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha ke andar se shuru hoti hai — ati-samvedansheel aur jaldi excite hone wala swabhav. Chhoti baatein dil par lag jaati hain. Apni is teevra oorja ko disha dena hi aapki asli jeet hai.
Shuruaat bhale hi ati-samvedansheel rahi ho, rekha aage jaakar seedhi ho jaati hai — umra ke saath aapne (ya aap) buddhi se apni bhavukta par vijay paayi hai. Yeh growth ka spashth sanket hai.
Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha se judi hui hai — gehri samvedansheelta aur savdhaani ka sanket. Aap apni pratibha ko kam aankte hain. Sach yeh hai ki aap jitna sochte hain usse kahin zyada capable hain.
Judi hui aur halki dhalti mastishk rekha — kalakaar ka mann. Samvedansheelta aapki kamzori nahi, aapki creative shakti ka source hai. Art, design, lekhan — inme aapka sparsh alag dikhega.
Bahar se shaant, andar se chattaan — samvedansheel hote hue bhi apne usoolon ke liye ant tak ladne ki shakti. Log aapki nazaakat dekhte hain, aapki determination ka andaza nahi laga paate.

Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha se thodi alag shuru hoti hai — utkrisht sanket. Swatantra soch, turant nirnay aur mansik saahas aapko bheed se alag karta hai. Aap flash mein woh samajh lete hain jo doosre mehnat se seekhte hain.

Alag aur seedhi mastishk rekha — logon par prabhaav daalne ki asadharan kshamata. Public-facing role (leadership, media, apna venture) mein aapki pratibha sabse zyada khilti hai. Bas ek clear purpose chahiye — bina lakshya ke yeh shakti bikhar jaati hai.
Rekhaon ke beech zyada doori — bejhijhak, impulsive aur suriyon mein rehne ki chaah. Himmat kamaal ki hai, lekin plans baar-baar badalna aapki pragati rok sakta hai. Ek cheez pakdo, poora karo.

Mastishk rekha halki si Chandra parvat ki or dhalti hai — kalpana par aapka niyantran hai. Aap imagination ko tool ki tarah use karte hain, uske gulaam nahi bante. Creative professionals ka aadarsh sanket.

Rekha gehri Chandra parvat mein utarti hai — kalpana ki duniya aap par haavi ho sakti hai. Mood ke hisaab se kaam hota hai aur mann kabhi-kabhi bhaari ho jaata hai. Routine, dhoop aur apne logon ka saath aapke liye dawa hai; mann zyada bojhal lage toh kisi apne se ya professional se baat karna samajhdari hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate II position 4, pp.18-19 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha ant mein Budh parvat ki or upar uthti hai — umra ke saath dhan kamane ki ichchha aur usko paane ka sankalp dono badhte jayenge. Business-mind aapke andar samay ke saath aur tez hoga.

Mastishk aur hriday rekha ek hi rekha ban gayi hai — ateev teevrata ka sanket. Jab aap kisi lakshya ya kisi vyakti ko chunte hain, toh dil-dimaag dono ki poori shakti usme jhonk dete hain. Yeh shakti akele chalne par sabse zyada kaam karti hai; sahi partner milna aapke liye life-changing hota hai.

Do alag mastishk rekhayein — dohri pratibha ka durlabh sanket. Aap do bilkul alag mansik duniyaon ko ek saath safalta se chala sakte hain (jaise naukri + apna venture). Prachin granthon mein ise dhan-prapti ka yog bhi mana gaya hai — lekin yeh dhan janm se nahi, aapki buddhi se aayega.

Mastishk rekha se ek mahin rekha upar uthti hai — jeevan ke us daur mein ek aisa practical breakthrough jo aapke poore character ko hamesha ke liye badal dega. Yeh nayi shakha samay ke saath doosri mastishk rekha jitni majboot ho sakti hai.

Mastishk rekha ko chhoota hua chaukor chinh (square) — raksha ka sanket. Jis daur mein yeh aata hai, wahan mushkilein aayengi lekin aap surakshit nikal jayenge. Ise prachin palmistry mein 'mark of preservation' kaha gaya hai.

Rekha ki shuruaat (Jupiter ke neeche) mein island — bachpan/shuruati padhai mein mann kam laga hoga, energy aur ambition der se jaagi. Lekin yeh sirf shuruaat ka daur tha; rekha aage saaf hai toh asli udaan baad mein aati hai.

Mastishk rekha jagah-jagah jhirri jaisi (chained) hai — mansik thakan aur focus toot-ne ka pattern. Yeh kamzori nahi, signal hai: neend, screen-time aur stress ka hisaab rakhna aapke liye doosron se zyada zaroori hai. Dimaag ko rest doge toh yahi rekha kamaal karegi.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate IV position 1, pp.22-23 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha lambi, gehri aur bina rukavat ke hai — majboot jeevan-shakti, achhi rog-pratirodhak kshamata aur mazboot constitution ka sanket. Aapki energy ka tank bada hai; use sahi kaam mein lagao.

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate VIII, pp.36-38 (vitality framing per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha kadi-jaisi (chained) hai — energy ke utaar-chadhav aur pachan/thakan par dhyan dene ka sanket. Yeh bhavishya ki sazaa nahi, sirf body ka manual hai: neend, khana aur recovery ko priority banao, tank bhara rahega.

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 1, pp.37-39 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chaudi lekin uthli jeevan rekha — sharirik taakat zyada, lekin dabav mein tikne wali nerve-force thodi kam. Aap mehnat ke ghode hain; bas lambi race ke liye stamina ke saath-saath mansik resilience bhi train karo.
Jeevan rekha ka ghera chauda hai, Shukra parvat khula hai — garam-josh, magnetic vyaktitva aur doosron ko apni or kheenchne wali energy. Aapki maujoodgi kamre ka mahaul badal deti hai.

Jeevan rekha angushtha se sati hui chalti hai — energy reserve seemit hai, isliye aap selective rehte hain ki kisme oorja lagani hai. Yeh smart hai; bas overcommitment se bacho aur recharge time ko non-negotiable rakho.

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 2, pp.39-40 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha upar Jupiter ki taraf se uthti hai — mahatvakanksha aapke jeevan ki steering hai. Self-control zabardast hai; aap apni zindagi goals ke hisaab se chalate hain, mood ke hisaab se nahi.

Jeevan rekha neeche Mangal kshetra se uthti hai — jawani mein gussa tez aur zid pakki. Umra aur anushasan ke saath yahi aag aapka fuel ban jaati hai. Trigger points pehchano, react karne se pehle 10 second ruko.

Jeevan rekha se upar Jupiter ki or uthti rekhayein — har rekha ek milestone effort hai: aage badhne, authority paane aur naam banane ki thos koshish. Jis umra par yeh rekha uthti hai, wahi aapke bade push ka samay hai.

sources.loc: Ch.III Ascending Lines, Plate X position 1, pp.41-42

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Ek koshish-rekha mastishk rekha par ruk gayi — us daur mein ek achhi shuruaat galat faisle se adhoori reh gayi (ya reh sakti hai). Sabak: bade decision par doosri raay lena aapke liye luxury nahi, zaroorat hai.

Ek koshish-rekha hriday rekha par jaakar rukti hai — us daur mein dil ke maamle career ke raaste mein aaye (ya aayenge). Yeh galat nahi hai; bas yeh jaan lo ki aapke liye pyaar aur ambition ko alag rakhna mushkil hai — dono ka balance hi aapka formula hai.

Jeevan rekha se uthti rekha bhagya rekha se jud jaati hai — behad shubh sanket. Us umra par aapne (ya aap) bandhan tod kar apni kismat khud likhne ka faisla kiya. Prachin niyam kehta hai: aisi hi swatantrata ki ghatna lagbhag dugni umra par dobara aati hai.

Jeevan rekha ke andar Mangal rekha maujood hai — yeh aapka reserve tank hai. Asadharan jeevan-shakti, jhatkon se ubharne ki taakat aur khatron ke beech suraksha ka prachin sanket. Sipahiyon aur risk lene walon ki hatheli ka nishan.
Jeevan rekha mein rukavat hai, lekin peeche Mangal rekha khadi hai — matlab jis daur mein jhatka aayega, wahin se recovery bhi hogi. Aapki bounce-back power aapki sabse badi property hai.

Mangal rekha se ek shakha Chandra parvat ki or jaati hai — bechaini aur romanch ki teevra bhookh. Yeh bhookh sahi channel maangti hai: travel, sports, naye challenges. Bina disha ke yeh energy aadaton ke galat raaste dhoondh leti hai — apne stimulation ka source soch-samajh kar chuno.

sources.loc: Ch.IV, Plate X position 5, pp.44-45 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha jeevan rekha se uthti hai — self-made kahani. Shuruati saal tang aur pariwar/paristhitiyon se bandhe rahe, lekin rekha jahan se saaf hoti hai, wahan se safalta apni mehnat aur merit se aati hai — kismat se nahi. Jis umra par rekha jeevan rekha se alag hoti hai, wahi aapki azaadi ka saal hai.
Bhagya rekha kalai se seedhi Shani parvat tak jaati hai aur saath mein Surya rekha bhi hai — bhagyashali destiny ka sabse sundar combination. Kismat, chamak aur safalta teeno aapke path par hain.

Bhagya rekha Chandra parvat se uthti hai — aapki unnati doosron ke sahyog, pasand aur samarthan se judi hai. Jeevan-saathi, sasural paksh, public ya prabhavshali log — aapki taraqqi mein doosron ka haath spashth rahega. Rishton mein invest karna aapke liye career-strategy hai.

sources.text: Samudrika tradition (cross-verification pending Hindi source pass)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chandra parvat se uthti bhagya rekha hriday rekha se jud jaati hai — sukhad aur samriddh vivah ka prachin sanket. Prem, romance aur saubhagya ka aisa sangam jisme jeevan-saathi ki pasand aur sahyog aapki kismat ko nayi disha dega.

Ek prabhav-rekha (influence line) bhagya rekha se aakar mil jaati hai — jis samay yeh milan hota hai, us samay kisi khaas vyakti ka aapke jeevan mein pravesh, aksar vivah ya sthayi saath ke roop mein. Yeh rekha jitni saaf, milan utna hi majboot.

sources.loc: Ch.V Influence Lines, Plate XIII position 3, p.57

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Prabhav-rekha bhagya rekha ke saath-saath chalti hai par milti nahi — koi vyakti aapke jeevan mein gehri jagah rakhta hai, lekin dono ki zindagiyan alag rehti hain. Jab tak rekha saath chalti hai, prabhav rahega; rishton mein clarity rakhna aapke hi haath mein hai.

Prabhav-rekha bhagya rekha ko kaat kar Jupiter ki or nikal jaati hai — savdhaan: koi vyakti aapke rishte ko apni mahatvakanksha ki seedhi bana sakta hai. Iska matlab sab par shak karna nahi — bas jo aapko use kare aur value na kare, use samay rehte pehchan lena.

Bhagya rekha se ek shakha Jupiter parvat ki or — jis umra par yeh shakha nikalti hai, wahan se adhikar, uchch pad aur logon par command ki shuruaat. Agar shakha parvat tak poori pahunchti hai, toh yeh us lakshya ke liye safalta ka sarvashreshth sanket hai.
Bhagya rekha se shakha Surya parvat ki or — dhan aur public pehchan dono ek saath. Naam bhi, daam bhi. Yeh un logon ka sanket hai jinki safalta chhupti nahi, chamakti hai.
Bhagya rekha se shakha Budh parvat ki or — vigyan, vyapar ya technology mein koi khaas uplabdhi ka sanket. Aapki safalta ka raasta buddhi aur len-den ki samajh se hokar jaata hai.

Bhagya rekha hatheli ke beech (Mangal kshetra) se shuru hoti hai — shuruati zindagi sangharsh bhari, har cheez ladkar paani padi. Lekin agar rekha yahan se majboot uthti hai (aur Surya ki or shakha ho), toh aap apni kismat ke khud architect hain — bina kisi sahare ke, sirf mehnat aur merit se.

sources.loc: Ch.V Rising from the Middle of the Palm, p.55

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha mastishk rekha se uthti hai — safalta der se aayegi, lekin poori tarah aapke dimaag ki kamai hogi. Yeh late-bloomer ka nahi, deep-thinker ka sanket hai: jab aayega, bada aayega.

Bhagya rekha mastishk rekha par jaakar ruk jaati hai — savdhaan: career ka sabse bada khatra bahar se nahi, apne hi kisi galat faisle se hai. Bade decisions par thanda dimaag, doosri raay aur data — yeh teen aapke bodyguard hain.

Bhagya rekha hriday rekha par ruk jaati hai — dil ke galat jagah lagne se career ko dhakka lagne ka sanket. Pyaar karna galti nahi hai; galat vyakti ke liye apne sapne chhodna galti hai. Rishta wahi sahi jo aapke lakshya ko bada kare, chhota nahi.

Bhagya aur hriday rekha milkar Jupiter parvat par chadhti hain — prem se prapti ka sarvottam yog. Aapka pyaar aapki ambition ka fuel banega; jeevan-saathi aur apne log aapko oopar uthayenge. Kismat aapke rishton ke raaste aayegi.

Bhagya rekha tooti hai lekin nayi rekha purani ke khatam hone se PEHLE shuru ho jaati hai — yeh break nahi, upgrade hai. Jagah, kaam ya position ka poora badlav, aur nayi rekha jahan se shuru hoti hai wahan se pragati. Planned transition aapke favour mein hai.

Do bhagya rekhayein — do samanantar careers ka yog: ek mukhya kaam, ek passion project (ya do alag duniya ek saath). Agar aage jaakar dono milti hain, toh jo rukavat do raahon ko alag rakhti thi, woh us mod par hat jaayegi.

sources.loc: Ch.V Double Lines of Fate, Plate XIV position 2, pp.57-58

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha halki hai lekin mastishk rekha zabardast — aap kismat ko maanne walon mein se nahi hain, aur aapko zaroorat bhi nahi. Aapki safalta shudh roop se aapke dimaag ki den hogi. Destiny aapke liye likhi nahi gayi; aap use roz likhte hain.

Bhagya aur mastishk rekha ke sangam par island — us daur mein apni hi soch se hue ek nuksaan (aksar paison ka) ka sanket. Yeh warning system hai, sazaa nahi: us phase mein bade financial faisle double-check karo, akele mat lo.

Bhagya rekha par Mangal kshetra mein island — ek daur aisa jisme career mein rukavat aur kharcha aamdani se aage nikal sakta hai. Us window mein reserve fund banaye rakhna aur naye bade daanv taalna hi samajhdari hai.

Surya rekha maujood hai — chumbakiya vyaktitva, logon par prabhav aur pehchan paane ki natural shakti. Yeh 'luck line' hai: jahan se yeh shuru hoti hai, wahan se zindagi mein roshni, samman aur avsar badhte jaate hain.

Surya rekha nahi dikhti — matlab talent ki kami nahi, limelight ki hai. Aapka kaam khud nahi bolega; aapko use bulwana padega. Visibility ko skill ki tarah treat karo — apna kaam dikhana seekhna hi aapka missing piece hai.
Surya rekha bhagya rekha se uthti hai — jis umra par yeh uthti hai, wahan se aapke career ko pakki pehchan milti hai. Yeh luck nahi, kamai hui izzat hai — apni mehnat se banayi hui.

Surya rekha Chandra parvat se uthti hai — public ki pasand se milne wali safalta. Creators, performers, speakers aur un sabka sanket jinki taraqqi audience tay karti hai. Chamak zabardast hogi, lekin public ka mood badalta hai — isliye income ke stable pillars bhi banao.

Surya rekha mastishk rekha se uthti hai — safalta dimaag se aayegi, aur zindagi ke doosre half mein aayegi. Padhne-likhne, research ya kisi vishesh gyaan ke kshetra mein aapki mehnat compound hokar milegi. Sabra rakhkho, curve exponential hai.

Surya rekha hriday rekha se uthti hai — jeevan ke baad ke varshon mein sukh aur samriddhi rishton ke raaste aayegi. Prachin niyam ise der se hone wale sukhi vivah aur antim varshon ke aaram ka pakka sanket maanta hai. Aapka best chapter aakhri chapters mein hai.

Surya rekha par island — ek daur aisa jisme naam ya izzat par sawal uth sakte hain (galatfehmi, controversy, reputation dip). Us window mein transparency hi aapka armour hai: sab kuch record par, sab kuch saaf. Island khatam, chamak wapas.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, Plate XV position 5, pp.65-66 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha par sitara (star) — hatheli ke sabse bhagyashali chinhon mein se ek. Asadharan pehchan, achanak bada avsar ya aisi safalta jiska sapna doosre dekhte hain. Jab yeh phase aaye, bade sapne dekhne se mat darna.

Surya parvat par bahut si chhoti rekhayein — pratibha ek nahi, kai hain. Lekin yahi problem bhi hai: bahut saare ideas, bikhra hua focus. Niyam yaad rakho — ek saaf Surya rekha sau bikhri rekhaon se behtar hai. Ek chuno, use jitao, phir agla.

Surya rekha par chaukor chinh — aapki position aur naam par hamla hoga toh bhi aap surakshit rahenge. Jalne wale jalte rahenge; square ka matlab hai unki koshishein aap tak pahunch kar bhi tikengi nahi.
Do-teen Surya rekhayein saath-saath samanantar chal rahi hain — do ya teen alag kshetron mein ek saath safalta ka yog. Multi-hyphenate hona aapke liye distraction nahi, design hai.
